english.title: Interfere with charging equipment or obscure registration plate to avoid payment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[interfered with equipment or with the functioning of equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUIPMENT..), used for or in connection with charging under a charging scheme]_
(B)_[caused or permitted the registration plate of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE REGISTRATION..), to be obscured]_

with intent to avoid payment of, or being identified as having failed to pay, a charge imposed by a charging scheme under Part III of the Transport Act 2000
english.legislation: Contrary to section 173(5) and (8) of the Transport Act 2000.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
with intent to avoid payment of OR
being identified as having failed to pay a charge imposed by a charging scheme under Part III of the Transport Act 2000
interfered with equipment / the functioning of equipment used for in connection with charging under the charging scheme OR

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
